content_blocks.text: The old house stood silent, its windows like dark eyes staring into the night. In the dim light of the streetlamp outside, the walls seemed to shift ever so slightly, as if the very fabric of reality was whispering secrets. As the wind whispered through the branches of the gnarled oak tree, it carried with it the faint scent of jasmine and the distant echo of laughter. Elianor stood at the threshold, her heart pounding against her ribcage, each beat a reminder of the stories that lingered within these walls. She reached out a trembling hand to touch the weathered door, feeling the chill that seemed to seep from every crevice. The past was heavy, pressing down on her like an unyielding weight, but she knew she could not turn back now.
